| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Deblurred image | Deblurred image, Show PSF | The deblurred image, or the estimated PSF, enlarged in the middle of a black image with its largest weight at 255. |
| **First guess sigma** `sigma` | 3 | 0.3 to 10 px | The first PSF is a Gaussian of this sigma, cut to the support. |
| **Support radius** `support` | 7 | 1 to 25 px | The PSF is kept inside a square of 2 r + 1 pixels around its center. |
| **Cycles** `cycles` | 10 | 1 to 100 | How many rounds of PSF steps and image steps to run. |
| **PSF steps per cycle** `psfSteps` | 5 | 1 to 20 | How many Richardson-Lucy steps update the PSF in each cycle, with the image fixed. |
| **Image steps per cycle** `imageSteps` | 5 | 1 to 20 | How many Richardson-Lucy steps update the image in each cycle, with the PSF fixed. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
